result.summary: I set up the environment with the repository's own Makefile and ran the whole suite with `make test`: 1751 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, in about 15.7 minutes. Setup used Python 3.10.18 in .venv (made by uv) and PostgreSQL 13 from compose.yaml, which I left running on localhost:5432. `make test` starts PostgreSQL if it is down, then runs `.venv/bin/pytest --create-db`, which builds a fresh test database each time. I did not change any product code, tests or git history, and the working tree is clean. The only side effect is local git config: `make setup` sets core.hooksPath to .githooks, so a pre-push hook now runs. There were about 15.5k warnings, mostly deprecation warnings from factory-boy and Django, and none of them failed a test. The last commit adds flake8 to requirements-devel.in. Its message says this change needs review.
